P.name: Shepherd of Souls
P.title: Template:Data Yorick/Shepherd of Souls
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Shepherd of Souls|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Yorick
|skill        = I
|icon         = Shepherd of Souls.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate- Final Service:}} Enemies that die near {{ci|Yorick}} will leave a ''grave'', as well as those he kills or damages with ''{{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}}''. '''Yorick''' can use ''{{ai|Awakening|Yorick}}'' and ''{{ai|Mourning Mist|Yorick}}'' to turn all ''graves'' into {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} that assist him in combat.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Innate - The Cursed Horde:}} {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} will autonomously advance a lane upon entering combat within. '''Yorick''' can have up to 4 {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}}.
|description = {{sbc|Innate - Final Service:}} Whenever '''Yorick''' uses ''{{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}}'' to score the killing blow on any enemy or damage an enemy {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, he raises a ''grave'' at {{tt|their location|Grave is spawned on top of the killed enemy and within close proximity of the damaged champion or monster}}. Additionally, a grave is passively raised for every {{pp|8th;7th;6th;5th;4th;3rd;2nd|1;3;5;7;9;11;13}} enemy that dies otherwise near him. Up to 4 ''graves'' can exist at once, lasting until '''Yorick''' exits the general area or {{tip|death|dies}}, with the furthest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.
|description2 = '''Yorick''' can use ''{{ai|Awakening|Yorick}}'' and ''{{ais|Mourning Mist|Yorick}}'' mark to raise 1 {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} from each ''grave'' after a 1-second delay, consuming the ''graves'' in the process.
|description3  = {{sbc|Innate - The Cursed Horde:}} Up to 4 {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} can be active at once near '''Yorick''' or near '''{{ui|Maiden of the Mist|The Maiden|nolink=true}}''', with the nearest one always being replaced by the newest upon raising one over the limit.
|description4 = ''See [[Yorick#Pets|Pets]] for more details about {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}}.''
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|1000|Grave summon range}}|{{tt|2500|Grave despawn range, pending for test}}}}
|notes   = 
* Damaging a large monster or champion with {{ai|Last Rites|Yorick}} will only spawn 1 grave, even if it kills them.
|yvideo       = u5VRRS8rcYc
}}

Q.name: Awakening
Q.title: Template:Data Yorick/Awakening
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Awakening|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Yorick
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Awakening.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yorick}} summons {{as|Mist Walkers|mist}} from the ''graves'' around him.
|pre-blurb = Yorick/Last Rites
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' exhumes a {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} under his command from each nearby ''grave''.
|range        = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1000
|effect radius= <!--{{tip|er|icononly = true}} 1000 pending for test-->
|targeting    = Proximity
|cast time    = none
|spelleffects = 
|affects      = Self
|notes   = 
* ''Awakening'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* ''Mist Walkers'' update their [[champion statistic|statistics]] correspondingly to '''Yorick's ''' during the periodic stat update, with the exception of their {{as|maximum health}}.
* ''Awakening'' cannot be cast without enough ''graves'' in '''range'''.
}}

W.name: Dark Procession
W.title: Template:Data Yorick/Dark Procession
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Dark Procession|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Yorick
|skill        = W
|icon         = Dark Procession.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Yorick}} summons a destructible ring of spirits at the target location that {{tip|airborne|knocks aside}} enemies hit. It remains as [[terrain]] against enemies for a few seconds.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Yorick''' summons a ring of spirits around the target location that arises after a {{fd|0.75}}-second delay, {{tip|airborne|knocking aside}} enemies hit by the walls over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, though not through terrain. Within {{tt|210-units|Estimated}}, they are pulled inside; otherwise they are pushed away. The ring remains for 4 seconds as impassible [[terrain]] against enemies, granting {{tip|sight}} inside the ring.
|description2 = ''Dark Procession'' can only be targeted by enemy {{tip|champion}} basic attacks and {{tip|turrets}}. The wall takes 1 [[damage]] per attack from champions and is destroyed instantly from turret attacks.
|leveling2    = {{st|Wall Health|{{ap|2|2|3|3|4}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|20 to 12}}
|cost         = 70
|cast time    = none
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = 600
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|225|Spirits spawn radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|200|Sight radius from center of ring}}}}
|customlabel  = Impassable perimeter
|custominfo   = {{tip|pathing radius|icononly = true}} {{tt|125|Inner radius}} - {{tt|325|Outer radius}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|spellshield  = false
|spelleffects = 
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* ''Dark Procession'' has a {{tip|turret}} prioritization value of 6, equal to that of {{ui|Blue Super Minion|link = super minion|super minions}}.
** '''Yorick's''' other {{tip|pet|pets}} each have a lower prioritization value, allowing him to delay the turret from targeting the {{ai|Eulogy of the Isles|Yorick|The Maiden}} or a {{as|Mist Walker|mist}} for one attack.
* ''Dark Procession'' deals 0 {{tip|proc damage|proc}} {{tip|true damage}} to enemies it knocks aside, which triggers [[combat status|in-combat]] effects such as drawing turret and [[Monster#Monster_Behavior|monster aggression]], {{ri|Sudden Impact}} or applying {{ii|Elixir of Sorcery}}.
* The perimeter is made up of 18 units with 100 {{tip|pathing radius}} and 20 {{tip|gameplay radius}} each, which interact with effects like {{cai|I|Warwick}}. [https://youtu.be/OXjhRp1Rd5s?si=sHg_NfUBput9cC0F&t=42]
* '''Yorick''' marks any enemy champion within repeatedly while the cage persists in order to gain [[Assist#Indirect_triggers_of_assist_credit|assist credit]], lasting for the standard credit timer.
|yvideo       = Mw3BWB8nqIA
}}
